reading.image_kind: label (photo of a yellow-green marbled vinyl LP, side A)
reading.notes: Only the center label of the record is visible, showing a dark tropical palm-tree scene with a large letter 'A'. The text at the top of the label is very small and hard to read; it may read 'Dreamtime/Dreamcatcher' above 'Long Player'. The small lines of text below the 'A' are illegible and no tracklist, durations, label name, catalogue number or barcode can be read. The vinyl is translucent yellow-green with black marbling.
